# === THE MICRO PREFIX (#1427) ===
# ⚠ THE ASCII-`u` ROWS ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT (#1450, closed not-planned). `a 5 um layer` really does read
# as the hesitation filler and `a 5 us delay` as the pronoun — the probe found both — and they are NOT
# being fixed. `um`/`us` are an ASCII-fallback convention from systems that could not encode `µ`; they
# survive in CSV exports and plain-text fields but are not what documents contain, and this engine's input
# is documents. ⚠ AND THE FIX WOULD BE UNUSUALLY DANGEROUS FOR THE INCIDENCE: `us` is a pronoun and `um`
# an interjection, so the rule fires on high-frequency tokens and is held off them only by a numeric
# left-context guard — the shape that produced the `.50 caliber` and `6′2″` regressions already.
# ⚠ THIS IS NOT THE SAME JUDGEMENT AS THE PRIME ROWS ABOVE. ASCII `"` and `'` are what keyboards produce
# today, not an antiquity, and `0.015"` drops the unit silently. Those rows stay.
